title: Agricultural and food market categories
description: Market contexts relevant to agricultural products, inputs, services and food-system exchange.

terms.label: Agricultural commodity market
terms.definition: A physical or referenced market for broadly standardized agricultural commodities.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include commodity-market context; individual Commodity entities and price series are deferred to a later market-data phase.

terms.label: Agricultural input market
terms.definition: A market for seeds, fertilizers, crop protection, feed, machinery and other production inputs.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include exchange and pricing of farm inputs; exclude primary agricultural outputs.

terms.label: Livestock market
terms.definition: A market for live farm animals and primary livestock transactions.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include live-animal exchange; exclude meat retail and animal-feed markets.

terms.label: Wholesale food market
terms.definition: A market where food and agricultural goods are traded in bulk before retail sale.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include wholesale and terminal markets; exclude direct consumer retail.

terms.label: Retail food market
terms.definition: A consumer-facing market for food products.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include supermarkets, shops and comparable food retail channels; exclude restaurants and wholesale trade.

terms.label: Agricultural export market
terms.definition: External demand and trading channels for agricultural or food exports.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include destination-market and export-access context; exclude domestic sales without an export dimension.

terms.label: Agricultural import market
terms.definition: Supply and trading channels through which agricultural or food goods enter a jurisdiction.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include import availability, dependence and access; exclude domestic supply without an import dimension.

terms.label: Agricultural futures market
terms.definition: A regulated or organized derivatives market referencing agricultural commodities.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include futures and options context; exclude physical spot trade and individual financial instruments as Product records.

terms.label: Agricultural land market
terms.definition: A market for sale, lease or valuation of land used for agriculture.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include agricultural land transactions; exclude general residential and commercial real estate.

terms.label: Agricultural labor market
terms.definition: Supply, demand, wages and mobility of labor used in agricultural production.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include farm and seasonal agricultural labor; exclude general employment without an agricultural connection.

terms.label: Agricultural logistics market
terms.definition: A market for transport, storage, cold-chain and distribution services serving agriculture and food.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include commercially supplied agri-food logistics services; exclude physical disruption classified only as an event.

terms.label: Food-processing market
terms.definition: Commercial demand and exchange involving food-processing capacity, services and outputs.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include processing-industry market conditions; exclude primary production and consumer retail alone.
